documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching ₹716.4 crore and EBITDA at ₹71.5 crore. The company recently commissioned its Marol, Mumbai facility in June 2026, adding approximately 4,000 kg per annum of capacity. Additionally, Shanti Gold is constructing a new facility in Jaipur on a 3-acre land space, which will add 1,200 kg per annum of capacity. The company has also approved a rights issue of up to ₹100 crore to support its growth strategies.

guidance.claim: Shanti Gold targets a total installed capacity of 7,900 kg per annum upon completion of its Jaipur facility.
guidance.quote: Total capacity on completion: 7,900 kg pa

margins_costs.claim: Shanti Gold expects higher production to improve fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency

margins_costs.claim: The company implements gold weight verification to control material usage and cost.
margins_costs.quote: Verify gold weight to control material usage & cost

margins_costs.claim: For Q1 FY27, the company achieved a gross margin of 10.9% and an EBITDA margin of 10.0%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 10.0% PAT Margin: 7.1% vs 323.0 kg in Q1 FY26

orders_capacity.claim: Shanti Gold's current installed capacity stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum across Andheri and Marol post-commissioning.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Upon completion of the Jaipur facility, the company's total capacity will reach 7,900 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Total capacity on completion: 7,900 kg pa

capital_allocation.claim: The company's steadily deleveraging balance sheet and improving returns signal strong fundamental momentum.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistently improving returns and a steadily deleveraging balance sheet signal strong fundamental momentum

risks_headwinds.claim: Shanti Gold aims to reduce concentration risk through expansion across regions, products, and export markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Expansion across regions, products, and export markets reduces concentration risk

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's performance is subject to risks such as market competition and the performance of the Indian and international economies.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and worldwide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy
